_meta.description: Baseline de código fuente verificado por lectura directa de git show origin/main. Todos los hechos son verificados a partir del SHA base.

api/src/app.ts.note: apiRouter mounts registerHealthRoutes + registerRoutes; app.use('/api', apiRouter) → all public paths are /api/*

api/src/routes.ts.idempotentWrapper: idempotent(fn) — checks X-Idempotency-Key header; key format: `${method}:${baseUrl}${path}:${headerValue}`

api/src/env.ts.sessionSecret: SESSION_SECRET — ephemeral fallback when AUTH_ENFORCEMENT=off; required when on
api/src/env.ts.cognitoJwtStatus: throws 'not yet implemented' — cognito-jwt.ts does not exist

api/src/health.ts.readyEndpoint: GET /api/health/ready → { ok: boolean, checks: { config: boolean, database: boolean }, now: string } — can return 503

infra/src/index.ts.content: 3-line placeholder — comment + export {}. Zero CDK constructs.

ADR-015.title: Modelo de acción y confirmación del agente
keyRules: Agent invokes structured tools — never generates or executes SQL
All agent-proposed mutations require visible draft + explicit PWA confirmation
Server cannot execute mutation on LLM decision alone
Idempotent execution: Dexie offline queue → X-Idempotency-Key → audit
Sensitive actions (expenses, inventory, deletions) require reinforced confirmation (distinguishable UI)
exceptionsToPWAConfirmation: External collaborator structured response via valid token
External verified events (SES delivery, TTL expiry, revocation)

ADR-018.title: Límites de la inteligencia agrícola
hardBoundaries: No recomendar pesticidas, fungicidas ni agroquímicos específicos
No diagnóstico definitivo — solo evaluación preliminar con aviso de seguridad
Toda evaluación visual incluye aviso de seguridad
